records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

We know getting started can slip. If you want a hand setting up your first project or inviting your team, just reply -- happy to help.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Lantern Collective
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Lantern Collective* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no milestone, and zero replies to two Wrenfield outreach emails (email:869c3406, email:45c04c52) or tickets. No sign of engagement, so unaided activation in the remaining 8 days looks unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Just checking in as you get going with Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the step that makes everything else click 
dash and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
